text: Yes, the sources agree on tree-cover loss in 2012. The Hansen dataset (GFC-2025-v1.13) observed a 1.4-hectare loss in 2012. The JRC GFC2020 dataset corroborates this, showing that 51% of this area was still forest in 2020, which meets the 50% threshold. The MGAP forest map (2021) indicates the area was planted forest (not native), with 0.4 hectares of *Pinus* species. All datasets confirm the event, though the MGAP data does not map native forest in the area.
